channel.title: Netrani Island Blog
channel.description: Guides to Netrani Island and Murudeshwar.

item.title: How to Reach Netrani Island: Train, Bus and Road via Murudeshwar
item.description: Netrani Island is reached only by a booked boat from Murudeshwar beach, 19 km out. How to reach Murudeshwar by train, bus or car from Mangaluru, Goa and Hubballi.

item.title: Is Scuba Diving Safe at Netrani? An Honest Guide for First-Timers
item.description: For healthy beginners who follow the briefing, a Netrani try dive is generally safe. The rules behind it, the real risks, why days get cancelled, what to ask.

item.title: Murudeshwar Trip Plan: A 2-Day Itinerary with Netrani Island
item.description: A 2-day Murudeshwar trip plan: temple, Shiva statue, Raja Gopura and beach on day one, the Netrani boat on day two, then Gokarna or Kollur. Timings and tips.

item.title: Murudeshwar Water Sports and Boating: Prices, Rides and Netrani
item.description: Murudeshwar water sports prices: jet ski ₹400–500, banana boat ₹300, speed boat ₹1,500, parasailing ₹800–1,000. What each ride is like, plus the Netrani boat.

item.title: Netrani Island Best Time to Visit: Season, Months and Is It Open Now
item.description: Netrani Island boats run roughly October to May and stop in the monsoon; December to February is usually calmest. Month-by-month guide and whether it is open now.

item.title: Netrani Island Resort and Stay: Where to Sleep for the Boat Trip
item.description: There is no resort or stay on Netrani Island and visitors do not land. Sleep in Murudeshwar, 19 km away, the night before your morning boat. Where to book.

item.title: Netrani Island Scuba Diving: A First-Timer's Guide to the Dive Day
item.description: Netrani scuba diving starts with a 19 km boat ride from Murudeshwar beach. See the dive day step by step, who can dive, the season and how the price is set.

item.title: Netrani Scuba Diving Age Limit: Kids, Seniors and Non-Swimmers
item.description: The minimum age for a Netrani try dive is usually 10. PADI sets no upper age, but a medical form decides. What applies to kids, over-45s and non-swimmers.

item.title: Scuba Diving in Karnataka: Where to Dive and Why Netrani Leads
item.description: Netrani Island, 19 km off Murudeshwar, is Karnataka's main coral reef dive. See how Kapu, Karwar and Malpe compare and how to plan the trip from Bengaluru.

item.title: Snorkeling vs Scuba Diving at Netrani: Which One Suits You?
item.description: Snorkelling at Netrani keeps you at the surface from ₹2,200 per guest; scuba takes you under with an instructor. Compare swimming, depth, age, cost, photos.
